name: Subscription Service Report
query:
SELECT si.name AS "Invoice:Link/Sales Invoice:140",
       si.customer AS "Customer:Link/Customer:160",
       COALESCE(la.property, l_old.property) AS "Property:Link/Property:160",
       la.unit AS "Unit:Link/Unit Master:130",
       si.from_date AS "From Date:Date:100",
       si.to_date AS "To Date:Date:100",
       sii.item_name AS "Service:Data:200",
       sii.qty AS "Qty:Float:80",
       sii.rate AS "Rate:Currency:120",
       sii.amount AS "Amount:Currency:140"
FROM `tabSales Invoice` si
LEFT JOIN `tabSales Invoice Item` sii ON si.name = sii.parent
LEFT JOIN `tabLease` l_old ON l_old.name = si.lease
LEFT JOIN `tabLease Agreement Invoice Schedule` lais ON lais.sales_invoice = si.name
LEFT JOIN `tabLease Agreement` la ON la.name = lais.parent
WHERE si.docstatus = 1
  AND si.from_date IS NOT NULL
  AND si.to_date IS NOT NULL
  AND sii.item_group = 'Services'
  AND sii.item_code = %(service_type)s
  AND (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR si.posting_date >= %(from_date)s)
  AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR si.posting_date <= %(to_date)s)
  AND (%(property)s IS NULL OR %(property)s = '' OR la.property = %(property)s OR l_old.property = %(property)s)
  AND (%(unit)s IS NULL OR %(unit)s = '' OR la.unit = %(unit)s)
  AND (%(tenant)s IS NULL OR %(tenant)s = '' OR si.customer = %(tenant)s)
ORDER BY si.posting_date DESC
